title: 3 The state of Assam registered the largest increase (9·2 per cent) followed by Kerala (6·5 per cent), Mysore (2·9 per cent), Madras (2·6 per cent) and Rajasthan (2·2 per cent) whereas noticeable decrease occurred in the states of Bihar (5·8 per cent), Bombay (5·3 per cent), Jammu and Kashmir (4·6 per cent) and Andhra Pradesh (4·1 per cent). Amongst the cities, Kanpur registered the largest increase (15·4 per cent), followed by Hyderabad (7·8 per cent) and Bombay (2·5 per cent), whereas there was noticeable decrease in Bangalore (4·7 per cent) and Madras and Delhi (4·4 per cent each).
